method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Private Health Insurance Act 2007, Compilation No. 42, compilation date 19 September 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 90, 2026 (Register id C2026C00412), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2007A00031.txt; the Private Health Insurance (Lifetime Health Cover) Rules 2015 and the Private Health Insurance (Incentives) Rules are not deposited (their matters are inputs); the formulas the text lost (ss 22-40(4), 22-45(4), 34-1(2), 34-5(2)) are transcribed by hand from the Word rendering of the same compilation in ../../registers/source-bundle/C2007A00031.formulas.md (2026-10-21)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the person deciding on hospital cover: s 34-25 (base day: 1 July after turning 31; later of that and the first anniversary of the Medicare eligibility day for a non-citizen; first anniversary of return if overseas; pre-2010 base day stands; Norfolk Island not covered), s 37-7 (not yet applying), s 34-15 (hospital cover, gold card, applicable benefits arrangement, Rules classes), s 34-1 (late-joiner increase, (age - 30) x 2% x base rate; lifetime health cover age on the 1 July before taking out cover), ss 37-1, 37-5, 37-10 (exceptions), s 34-5 and s 34-20 (dropping cover; suspension, overseas over a year, the first 1,094 days permitted; years rounded up), s 34-10 (stops after 10 years; restarts), s 37-15 (70% cap), s 37-20 (joint cover), ss 22-30, 22-35, 22-40 (tier 1-3 earners; indexed thresholds are inputs; the s 22-40(4) child increase, $1,500 x (children - 1), from the formulas sidecar), ss 22-5, 22-15, 22-20 (rebate 30/35/40% less 10/20 points, nil for tier 3; adjusted percentages are inputs; no rebate on the loading; split between PHIIBs), ss 55-5, 55-10, 55-15 (community rating), s 102-1. Not encoded: s 22-25, s 22-45 indexation worked out, Division 23 registration machinery, Division 40, s 45-1 (in the Medicare Levy Act baseline), Parts 3-3 and 3-4 beyond s 102-1, Chapters 4-6, machinery.
seat: the person deciding on hospital cover (the adult whose premiums lifetime health cover loading, the rebate and community rating apply to)
